name: ROICO Bobby wall and ceiling painting robot
summary: Lightweight painting robot from Denmark that sprays paint onto interior walls and ceilings up to 3.5 m high from the crew's own paint pump. A ROICO operator stays on site during use.

germany.statusNote: Danish company; the page read shows price on request and an on-site operator service model, but no contact route for Germany or the EU was found.

specs.label: Spray speed (vendor)
specs.conditions: up to; vendor figure from the ROICO homepage

specs.label: Setup time
specs.value: About 5 to 10 minutes, no BIM or pre-scan
specs.quote: It sets up in 5 to 10 minutes with no BIM or pre-scan

specs.label: Control
specs.quote: starts it from a mobile app

notes: Moves across the wall by itself; drive type and spray mechanism are not described on the page read.
Detects objects, people and no-paint zones such as windows, sockets and doorways and stops when obstacles are present.

evidence.task: Sprays interior walls and ceilings on live fit-out sites with painters doing the skilled work
evidence.note: City 2 store fit-out with Malerfirmaet Preben Kjær & Lobe; also tested for a year on sites in Denmark (e.g. Jyske Bank premises). The page counts 23 deployments by 3 companies.

openQuestions: No ROICO website could be read; maker contact and price are unknown.
